meta.name: lifecycle-play-advisor
meta.description: Diagnose where a product sits in its lifecycle and which play fits — extend, replace, or retire. Use when a product is fading and you need the call, not just the worry.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 判断产品所处生命周期阶段，给出扩展、替换或退市的决策建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正为一个增长停滞的产品犹豫该投入改造还是退出。
copy.tagline_en: Decide your product lifecycle play: extend, replace, or retire.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are deciding whether to keep investing in a fading product or let it go.

howto.what: 引导你回答最多四问：先弄清产品和触发原因，再用七个转型问题定位生命周期阶段，识别压力来源（需求/成本/技术），测试扩展是否可行，最后推荐扩展、替换、退役、收割或暂不动，并给出理由、风险与下一步。
howto.when: 当你说出一个正在衰退的产品，并想判断该扩展、替换还是退役时触发；也可只给产品名，让它通过提问引导。

say.text: 我们的报表模块连续六个季度持平，大家想重写。该扩展、替换还是退役？
say.note: 它会先提问确定阶段和压力来源，再给建议。

say.text: 领导想砍掉零件模块，帮我判断这样对吗？
say.note: 它会用七个问题检验是否真在衰退。

say.text: 这个产品收入一直不涨，帮我看看是扩展还是替换？
say.note: 它会测试扩展方案是否可行，再推荐。

howto.what_en: Guides you through up to 4 questions, establishes stage via 7 transition questions, identifies pressure source, tests extension, then recommends Extend/Replace/Retire/Harvest/Nothing yet with reasoning, hazards, next steps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a product is fading and you need to decide extend/replace/retire; also when you name a product and let it ask questions.

say_en.text: Reporting module flat 6 quarters; team wants rewrite. Extend, replace, retire?
say_en.note: It asks questions to establish stage and pressure first.

say_en.text: Leadership wants to kill our parts module. Is that right?
say_en.note: Checks with the seven questions if it's really declining.

say_en.text: This product's revenue isn't growing. Help me decide extend vs replace.
say_en.note: It tests the extension play before recommending costlier options.
